title: RWA DEX and DeFi Report With Token Terminal: Trading Volume and TVL, Past 30 Days
description: Trading volume and value locked across stablecoins, tokenized funds, commodities and stocks.

blocks.text: This is a 30-day edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. Instead of market cap and holders, it looks at where tokenized assets are being used: trading volume on decentralized exchanges and value locked in DeFi protocols. It covers stablecoins, tokenized funds, tokenized commodities and tokenized stocks, by venue or protocol and by chain.

parts.text: This is a 30-day edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. blocks.text: All figures are taken strictly from Token Terminal as of October 12, 2026, and cover the past 30 days. No third-party data has been added, and no figures have been adjusted or estimated.

blocks.text: DEX figures show the change in trading volume over the past 30 days compared with the 30 days before. DeFi TVL figures show the change in value locked over the past 30 days. Where Token Terminal lists several versions or pools of the same protocol, such as Uniswap V2, V3 and V4 or Raydium's CLMM and CPMM pools, they are combined into one figure. Each chart is built from Token Terminal's top 10 list, and totals are sums of those entries only.

blocks.text: Overview

parts.text: Overview

blocks.text: Stablecoins dominated both measures. Stablecoin DEX volume across the top venues rose $12.2 billion, led by Uniswap, and stablecoin DeFi TVL rose $2.2 billion, led by Morpho. Tokenized stock DEX volume rose about $3.2 billion across the top venues, but by chain it shifted sharply, away from BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain toward Solana and Base.

blocks.text: Conclusion

parts.text: Conclusion

blocks.text: Over the past 30 days, stablecoins accounted for most of the growth in RWA DEX trading and DeFi deposits, with Uniswap and Morpho leading. Tokenized stock trading grew on Solana and Base while falling on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain. Tokenized funds and commodities are still small in DeFi, with growth concentrated in a handful of protocols.
